messages.subject: Seeking for R mentors for project "Symbolic Computation in R"
parts:
Dear all,

I am just quickly giving some info on the project idea.

SymEngine is a standalone fast C++ symbolic manipulation library, the idea is to wrap symengine into a R package to provide symbolic computation capacities within R. Also see the wiki page at https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/Symbolic-Computation-in-R.

Isuru Fernando <isu...@gmail.com> is willing to mentor on symengine side, and is anyone interested to mentor on R side? Also for students who are interested, please learn about symengine from the wiki page. The time left is not too much, if no appropriate student can be found, the project may be leaved to next year.

Best,
